variants.name: 200 ml
variants.about_this_item: Behaviour-correction spray that teaches a dog not to relieve itself in the wrong places. Corrects the behaviour and removes unpleasant smells.
variants.ingredient_information: Methyl nonyl ketone repels dogs without causing discomfort to people; wormwood gives an unpleasant taste; the "Apelsinia" perfume composition scents the room and removes unpleasant smells.
variants.feeding_instructions: Shake the bottle and spray from 20–30 cm onto the surface that attracts, or is expected to attract, the pet. Repeat as needed, preferably twice a day. Where the product cannot be applied to the object itself, spray a piece of cloth and place it next to the area to be protected. Keep the toilet area clean; never punish the pet physically during the training.
